understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose an action: MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT shifts the player one tile horizontally, then gravity automatically carries the player along the gravity direction until landing on a solid/support tile, reaching the goal '+', or hitting a hazard. Spikes ('u'/'v') are instant-fail if landed on. CLICK targets a specific [x,y] tile to interact with it (notably removing breakable 'x' blocks) without consuming horizontal-move progress; UNDO reverts the previous action. Planning relies on the provided previews (left_landing/right_landing and corridor_scan) to pick safe moves and prioritize passage columns that drop to a different y-level, using clicks to open blocked fall paths when no passage is available.
